fair.title: ChatGPT, fairly
fair.body: ChatGPT is OpenAI’s assistant, used by more than 900 million people a week. It starts in one click, its text chat is free, and it is very capable. Your conversations are kept on OpenAI’s servers, and on its personal plans they help train OpenAI’s AI unless you turn that off in its Data controls.

better.title: Where ChatGPT does better
better.items: One account on every device: your history follows you. {name} keeps it on this device, unless you set up sync on a computer.
Spoken conversation and polished phone apps.
Pictures made in the app, with nothing to set up.
It starts in one click. {name} asks you to pick an AI first.
both.title: Use both
both.cards: In ChatGPT: Settings › Data controls › Export data. Drop the file it sends you in {name}: every conversation comes in, nothing twice.
The payslip with the AI on this computer, the trip plan with ChatGPT. Switch from the box and ask again.
Plus or Pro, on a computer, through This computer: a line you paste once, then you sign in to ChatGPT. No second subscription.
catch.items: {name} is free; the AI behind it may not be.
No sign-up only with the AI on this computer, which needs 12 GB of memory and a recent graphics chip. Not on phones.
Your ChatGPT plan needs This computer: a line to paste once, on a computer.
Your work lives in this browser. Clear its data without a backup and it’s gone.
faq.items: Can I keep my ChatGPT conversations?
Yes. Export them from ChatGPT and drop the file in {name}. They stay yours, in plain files on your device.
With the AI on this computer, nothing you write leaves it. With an AI online, ChatGPT included, that provider reads what you send, as in its own app. {name} adds no server of its own.
Not with the AI on this computer. The free one asks for an OpenRouter account.
Is there a European ChatGPT alternative?
{name} is made in France and open source, and its AI can be European too: Mistral’s with your key, or one on your own computer.
end.title: Try {name}, and bring ChatGPT with you
